keyword.title: Keyword
keyword.description: Free-text search across grant descriptions (e.g. "climate resilience", "opioid treatment", "broadband"). Leave blank to skip keyword filtering.

agency.title: Awarding agency
agency.description: Exact top-tier awarding agency name (e.g. "Department of Health and Human Services", "National Science Foundation"). Leave blank for all agencies.

recipientState.title: Recipient state
recipientState.description: Two-letter US state code to limit to recipients located there (e.g. "CA"). Leave blank for all states.

minAwardAmount.title: Minimum award amount (USD)
minAwardAmount.description: Only return awards at or above this dollar amount.

daysBack.title: Days back
daysBack.description: How many days back from today to search, by award start date.

maxResults.title: Max results
maxResults.description: Maximum number of awards to return, largest award amount first.
